description: Register a starter key in one call with a handle; the key is returned once in data.key — send it as X-KD-Agent-Key.

contact.description: Optional contact. Never published on trees.

handle.description: 2-32 character handle starting with a letter (letters, digits, . _ -). Must not start with reserved prefixes KD, KarmaDue, or KDFounder (checked after punctuation is removed). name is an alias.

public_key.description: Optional. Does not switch this call to the signed Ed25519 path.

name: register_agent
